meta.description: Landscape installation in Grand Rapids: grading, sod and seed, plantings, retaining walls and steps, and irrigation installs for homes and commercial sites.

hero.kicker: Landscape installation in Grand Rapids and West Michigan
hero.title: Built for the site. **Built to last.**
hero.lede: From a bare lot to a finished yard, or a tired one made new: grading, topsoil, sod and seed, plantings, edging and mulch, retaining walls and steps, and irrigation installed by our own crew, for homes and commercial properties.

blocks.title: Every phase, **one crew.**
body: Whether you are starting from scratch with a new yard or upgrading an outdoor space you already have, we handle every phase: grading, topsoil, sod and seed, plantings, edging and mulch. Every plan is tailored to the site, with a focus on how it performs over the years and how it looks on day one.

We work closely with you to understand what you want, give you straight recommendations, and build something that works as well as it looks. We only recommend plants and features that will thrive in West Michigan, not just survive one season here.
checks: Grading, topsoil and sod or seed for a lawn that starts right
Plants chosen for your soil and light, so they thrive without constant care
Edging and mulch to finish every bed

blocks.title: Turn a slope into **ground you can use.**
body: When a property has slopes or changes in grade, the right retaining wall does more than hold back soil. It makes flat, usable space, defines safe steps between levels, stops erosion and helps the property drain.

We build walls and steps in a range of materials and styles, with the structure the site needs underneath. The timber steps pictured are a CAMP job: gravel treads set into a mulched slope beside the house.
checks: Walls that hold the grade and stop erosion
Steps that make a hill safe and easy to use
Materials and styles to match the home

blocks.title: A lawn that starts **level and takes.**
blocks.intro: Most lawn problems start under the grass. We fix the ground first, then put the lawn down.

items.title: Grading
items.body: Low spots, slopes and rough ground reshaped so water runs away from the house and the new lawn lies flat.

items.title: Topsoil
items.body: A proper layer of topsoil spread and raked, so seed and sod have something to root into.

items.title: Sod or seed
items.body: Sod for a finished lawn now, or seed and hydroseed for larger areas, put down clean and ready to water.

blocks.title: The sprinklers go in **with the yard.**
body: Irrigation is a big part of what we build: about a quarter of our recent projects have been irrigation installs. Plenty of landscape companies have to sub that work out. We do not. The same crew that grades and plants the yard lays the lines, sets the heads and programs the controller.

Because the system is planned with the landscape, every bed and every stretch of lawn gets the water it needs from day one. After that we can start it each spring, [service it](/irrigation/#service) through the season and blow it out before the freeze.
checks: Installed by CAMP's own crew, never subbed out
Zones planned around the new lawn, beds and plantings

blocks.title: Design it, build it right, **then keep it.**

steps.title: Sit down and design
steps.body: We meet at the property, talk through how you want to use the space, and plan a landscape that fits the site and the way you live.

steps.title: Build it right
steps.body: Materials and plants chosen for looks and for our climate, put in by our crew with the grading and base work done properly underneath.

steps.title: Keep it healthy
steps.body: Then, if you want, we maintain it, with [landscape management](/landscape-management/) and [irrigation](/irrigation/) service, so the investment stays polished year round.

blocks.title: New entries, islands **and common areas.**
body: Installation is not only for homes. We plant entries, islands and common areas for apartment communities, offices and HOAs, then keep them up on a [landscape management](/landscape-management/) plan, so the property does not slide back after the crew leaves.
For bigger site changes, walls, steps and grading are handled by CAMP, and tree removals by our sister company, [Ole Man RB's Tree Service](https://olemanrb.com/).

blocks.title: They took the time **to do it right.**

faq.a: Grading, topsoil, sod and seed, plantings, edging and mulch, plus retaining walls and steps and irrigation installs. We handle every phase with our own crew, for homes and commercial properties.

faq.q: Do you build retaining walls in Grand Rapids?
faq.a: Yes. We build retaining walls and steps across greater Grand Rapids to manage changes in grade, stop erosion and create usable flat space. The before and after photos on this page are CAMP jobs.

faq.q: Will the plants survive a Michigan winter?
faq.a: We only recommend plants that will thrive in West Michigan soil and our unpredictable seasons, chosen for your soil and light, so you are not replacing them after one hard winter.

faq.q: Do you install sod or seed new lawns?
faq.a: Yes. We grade the ground, spread topsoil, and put down sod or seed, including hydroseed for larger areas, as part of a new yard or on its own.

faq.q: Do you install irrigation with a new landscape?
faq.a: Yes, with our own crew. About a quarter of our recent projects have been irrigation installs. We plan the zones with the landscape, install the system, and can then start it up, service it and winterize it every year. See [irrigation installation](/irrigation/).

faq.q: Do you do commercial landscape installation?
faq.a: Yes. We install entries, islands and common area landscapes for apartment communities, offices and HOAs, and can maintain them afterward. See [commercial grounds care](/commercial/).

faq.q: Can you maintain the landscape after it is installed?
faq.a: Yes. Most of our installs move straight onto a [landscape management](/landscape-management/) plan with mowing, bed care and mulch, plus [irrigation](/irrigation/) service.

faq.q: How much does landscape installation cost?
faq.a: Every project is different, so we price it after we have seen the property and talked through what you want. Call or text [(616) 308-4862](tel:+16163084862) to schedule an on-site estimate.

quote.title: Start with a walk of the property.
